info.title: The words of the plugin database

PLUGIN_DB_ADDRESS_FORMATS.description: The one address form of a plugin: <format>:<id>, or clap@<sha256>:<id> when several files share one CLAP id, the sha256 that of the .clap file. An LV2 address carries no sha256: the bundle rule makes one bundle the plugin. A path is never part of an address, so a session keeps its plugins on another machine. The format is one of these words; an id is the plugin's own, its CLAP id or its LV2 URI, and a CLAP id that begins with '/' is a path and no address.

oneOf.title: clap
oneOf.description: a CLAP plugin: the id is the plugin descriptor's id

oneOf.title: lv2
oneOf.description: an LV2 plugin: the id is the plugin's URI

PLUGIN_DB_PIN_SHA256_HEX_LEN.description: The characters of a SHA-256 digest written in hex, two a byte: the length of every file digest a pin records and of the buffer a reader writes one into. Declared here so that a consumer that needs the length and no digest (plugin-hostd's command parser) reads it without OpenSSL; pin.h names it PHD_SHA256_HEX_LEN.

PLUGIN_DB_BUNDLE_RULES.description: Which LV2 bundle is the plugin, when several bundles of the search path name it: the one rule in force, and the only word of this item. A bundle realises the plugin when its manifest names the plugin with an lv2:binary; one that only names it (a MOD GUI, a preset bundle) complements it. The candidates are the realising bundles, or, when none realises it, the bundles that name it.

oneOf.title: newestVersion
oneOf.description: of the candidates, the one whose manifest gives the plugin the highest lv2:minorVersion, then the highest lv2:microVersion, a version not stated counting as 0; of equal versions the first in the search path, its directories in order and the bundles of one directory in byte order of their names. This is lilv's rule, so the host loads the bundle plugin-db pins.

PLUGIN_DB_LAYERS.description: The layers of an entry, each with one writer. An entry is a directory of the store, and each layer is one file of it, the word and .json, in the envelope data/store.schema.json declares. The entry is the join of its layers at read time and is never stored.

oneOf.title: declared
oneOf.description: meaning, units, travel and defaults, installed with the package by the plugin's owner, read only

oneOf.title: scanned
oneOf.description: identity, controls, ports, presets and GUI evidence, written by plugin-qualify under its runner

oneOf.title: pinned
oneOf.description: the files of the plugin with their digests and the layout fingerprint, written through plugin-db

oneOf.title: measured
oneOf.description: latency, cost and behaviour per rate and quantum with the conditions, written by the probes; may be wiped

oneOf.title: judged
oneOf.description: the record: verdict, conditions and what it was measured under, written by plugin-qualify's judgement

oneOf.title: reference
oneOf.description: a record from a reference machine, installed by plugin-db-qualification, read only

oneOf.title: corrected
oneOf.description: renames, hidden controls and scale a person chose, written by the override module

oneOf.title: warnedOverride
oneOf.description: a person's choice to run a refused plugin anyway, alone; it binds the pin it was written for and does not survive an upgrade

oneOf.title: observed
oneOf.description: crash and xrun history, written by plugin-hostd and the engine

PLUGIN_DB_FILES.description: What the check found of the plugin's files against its pinned layer, as rpm -V reports an attribute. Could not test is never same.

oneOf.title: same
oneOf.description: every file the plugin loads is held by the pin and has the digest the pin holds

oneOf.title: changed
oneOf.description: a file differs from its digest, is gone, is new, or another bundle is now the plugin

oneOf.title: absent
oneOf.description: the plugin is in no file of the search path any more, or its pinned file is gone

oneOf.title: couldNotTest
oneOf.description: there is no pinned layer, or a file or the pin could not be read

PLUGIN_DB_LAYOUT.description: What the check found of the plugin's parameter layout against the layout fingerprint of its pinned layer.

oneOf.title: same
oneOf.description: the layout has the pinned fingerprint: the files are the pinned bytes, or a host found the pinned fingerprint

oneOf.title: changed
oneOf.description: a host found another fingerprint than the pinned one

oneOf.title: notYetKnown
oneOf.description: the pin holds no layout, or the files changed and no host has found their layout yet

PLUGIN_DB_RECORD.description: Whether the judged layer, the record, answers for these bytes on this machine now.

oneOf.title: current
oneOf.description: it was written for the pinned bytes and layout, and nothing of PLUGIN_DB_RECORD_CHANGES makes it stale
oneOf.x-text: Its record is current.

oneOf.title: stale
oneOf.description: it exists, and a change of PLUGIN_DB_RECORD_CHANGES, or files that could not be tested, keep it from answering
oneOf.x-text: Its record no longer applies.

oneOf.title: none
oneOf.description: there is no judged layer
oneOf.x-text: It has no record.

PLUGIN_DB_RECORD_ACTIONS.description: What a change since a record was written asks for, each in the group of PLUGIN_DB_RECORD it leaves the record in.

oneOf.title: fullPath
oneOf.description: scan, pin, measure and judge again
oneOf.x-text: Scan, measure and judge it again.

oneOf.title: measureHere
oneOf.description: measure and judge on this class of machine; the record stays valid for its own class
oneOf.x-text: Measure it on this machine.

oneOf.title: convert
oneOf.description: convert the record to the schema in force, with no new measurement
oneOf.x-text: Convert the record; nothing is measured again.

oneOf.title: rejudge
oneOf.description: judge the measurements again, automatically, with no new measurement
oneOf.x-text: Judge the measurements again; nothing is measured again.

oneOf.title: remeasureBackground
oneOf.description: the record stays current, shown as measured under the host it names, and is measured again in the background
oneOf.x-text: The record still applies; it is measured again in the background.

PLUGIN_DB_RECORD_CHANGES.description: What may have changed since a record was written, each the row of the staleness table with the action it asks for. When several changed, the first in this order answers.

oneOf.title: files
oneOf.description: the plugin's files are not the bytes the record was written for, or could not be tested
oneOf.x-text: Its files changed.

oneOf.title: layout
oneOf.description: the parameter layout is not the one the record was written for, or is not yet known
oneOf.x-text: Its parameters changed.

oneOf.title: hostingChange
oneOf.description: the host is a release that declares a hosting change: its hosting epoch is past the record's. The host's owner declares it in the contract; no reader guesses
oneOf.x-text: The host changed how it hosts plugins.

oneOf.title: machineClass
oneOf.description: this machine is of another class than the record's
oneOf.x-text: This is another kind of machine.

oneOf.title: schema
oneOf.description: the record schema in force is not the record's
oneOf.x-text: The record format changed.

oneOf.title: rules
oneOf.description: the judgement rules in force are not the ones the record was judged by
oneOf.x-text: The qualification rules changed.

oneOf.title: hostVersion
oneOf.description: the host is a normal release other than the one the record was measured under
oneOf.x-text: The host is another release.

PLUGIN_DB_STATES.description: What a plugin is, from its attributes, its record, a shipped record and a warned override, answered by one function and by no reader for itself. There is no upgraded and no crashed state: new bytes have no record, so they are unqualified. Each state is in the group of PLUGIN_DB_RUNS it runs as; a refusal a warned override covers runs alone instead.

oneOf.title: unqualified
oneOf.description: no current record, for any reason: runs alone in its own limited worker, never grouped; shown as not qualified, with the reason
oneOf.x-text: Not qualified: it runs alone, in a worker of its own.

oneOf.title: qualified
oneOf.description: a current record whose verdict allows it and whose conditions are met here: runs as the verdict and the placement rules allow
oneOf.x-text: Qualified: it runs as its record allows.

oneOf.title: isolatedOnly
oneOf.description: a current record that says it is safe only alone: runs alone
oneOf.x-text: Qualified to run alone only.

oneOf.title: conditionsUnmet
oneOf.description: a current record with no cell for this rate or quantum, or a condition that fails here: runs alone, as unqualified
oneOf.x-text: Its record does not cover this machine's settings: it runs alone.

oneOf.title: refused
oneOf.description: a current record or a shipped refusal says refused: not loaded, unless a warned override says run alone
oneOf.x-text: Refused: it is not loaded.

oneOf.title: absent
oneOf.description: the files are gone: not loaded
oneOf.x-text: Its files are gone: it is not loaded.

PLUGIN_DB_RUNS.description: How a state runs at load.

oneOf.title: shared
oneOf.description: as the verdict and the placement rules allow, in a worker other plugins may share
oneOf.x-text: Runs in a shared worker.

oneOf.title: alone
oneOf.description: in its own limited worker, never grouped
oneOf.x-text: Runs alone, in a worker of its own.

oneOf.title: notLoaded
oneOf.description: not loaded: shown with its reason and its saved values kept; an effect passes audio through, an instrument is silent
oneOf.x-text: Not loaded: an effect passes audio through, an instrument is silent.

PLUGIN_DB_REASONS.description: Why a plugin is in its state, each in the group of PLUGIN_DB_STATES it explains: what show prints beside the state.

oneOf.title: neverPinned
oneOf.description: there is no pinned layer: never scanned or never pinned
oneOf.x-text: It has never been scanned.

oneOf.title: measurementPending
oneOf.description: pinned, and there is no record yet
oneOf.x-text: It has not been measured yet.

oneOf.title: couldNotTest
oneOf.description: the files or the pin could not be read
oneOf.x-text: Its files could not be read.

oneOf.title: filesChanged
oneOf.description: the files are not the pinned bytes
oneOf.x-text: Its files have changed since they were scanned.

oneOf.title: layoutChanged
oneOf.description: the layout is not the pinned one
oneOf.x-text: Its parameters have changed since they were scanned.

oneOf.title: layoutNotYetKnown
oneOf.description: the pin holds no layout, so a record cannot bind one
oneOf.x-text: Its parameters are not known yet.

oneOf.title: recordStale
oneOf.description: the record is stale for a change of PLUGIN_DB_RECORD_CHANGES, which show names with its action
oneOf.x-text: Its record no longer applies and it needs measuring again.

oneOf.title: notMeasuredUnderHost
oneOf.description: the verdict says alone, and the record was not measured under plugin-hostd, which isolated only needs
oneOf.x-text: Its record says alone, but it was not measured under plugin-hostd.

oneOf.title: verdictAllows
oneOf.description: the record's verdict allows a shared worker and its conditions are met here
oneOf.x-text: Its record allows a shared worker.

oneOf.title: verdictIsolated
oneOf.description: the record's verdict says it is safe only alone
oneOf.x-text: Its record says it is safe only alone.

oneOf.title: referenceOnly
oneOf.description: a shipped record matches the pin and was measured on another class of machine: reference figures only, until measured here
oneOf.x-text: Measured on another kind of machine: reference figures only.

oneOf.title: noCell
oneOf.description: the record has no cell for this rate and quantum
oneOf.x-text: Its record has no measurement at this rate and quantum.

oneOf.title: conditionFails
oneOf.description: a condition of the record does not hold here, or is not known here
oneOf.x-text: A condition of its record does not hold on this machine.

oneOf.title: recordRefused
oneOf.description: the record says refused; the way back is a rescan, a requalification or a warned override that runs it alone
oneOf.x-text: Its record says refused.

oneOf.title: shippedRefusal
oneOf.description: a shipped record of these bytes says refused, which wins over everything and no warned override overrides
oneOf.x-text: These files are refused by the record shipped with them.

oneOf.title: filesGone
oneOf.description: the plugin's files are gone; show names the path that was pinned
oneOf.x-text: Its files are gone.

PLUGIN_DB_ISOLATION_HOSTS.description: The hosts a verdict of isolated must have been measured under to make a plugin isolated only: a record that says alone and names another host leaves the plugin unqualified.

oneOf.title: pluginHostd
oneOf.description: the daemon that hosts plugins for use, in workers of their own

PLUGIN_DB_SOURCES.description: Where the record that answers comes from, as show prints it.

oneOf.title: none
oneOf.description: no record answers
oneOf.x-text: No record.

oneOf.title: local
oneOf.description: the judged layer: measured here
oneOf.x-text: Measured on this machine.

oneOf.title: reference
oneOf.description: the reference layer: a shipped record, measured on a reference machine
oneOf.x-text: Measured on a reference machine.

PLUGIN_DB_BAR.description: The bar a person sets for what may load, a user setting on both surfaces whose three words are declared here and read by plugin-hostd and both surfaces: the picker's and the menu's default view follow it. It filters a view and never changes what the reader answers; a refused plugin stays listed with its reason.

oneOf.title: qualifiedOnly
oneOf.description: only plugins whose state is qualified are offered by default
oneOf.x-text: Offer qualified plugins only.

oneOf.title: warnOnCrashes
oneOf.description: every plugin that is not refused or absent is offered, and only a crash is asked about
oneOf.x-text: Offer every plugin that is not refused; ask only after a crash.

oneOf.title: loadAll
oneOf.description: every plugin is offered, the way back from a refusal included
oneOf.x-text: Offer every plugin, refused ones included.

PLUGIN_DB_LATENCY.description: Where a measured latency figure stands against the latency line, which plugin-qualify's judgement declares once and writes into the record as latencyLineMs beside the figure of each cell as latencyMs. Over the line is information: the plugin loads. A record without the line, or a cell without the figure, is unmeasured and never a guess.

oneOf.title: within
oneOf.description: the figure is at or under the line
oneOf.x-text: Latency within the line.

oneOf.title: over
oneOf.description: the figure is over the line: shown by the owner's text, and the plugin loads
oneOf.x-text: Latency over the line; it still loads.

oneOf.title: unmeasured
oneOf.description: the record has no line, or the cell has no figure
oneOf.x-text: Latency not measured.

PLUGIN_DB_PIN_LAYOUT_FORMATS.description: The formats the layout serialisation is written for, as the first line of its bytes names them.

oneOf.title: clap
oneOf.description: every parameter clap.params gives, sorted by id

oneOf.title: lv2
oneOf.description: every control port, sorted by index

banner: Rendered by `omx-contract render --target c --package plugin-db` from the domain plugin-db, the numbers
plugin-db declares. It includes nothing, so a consumer that needs a number and no digest builds without OpenSSL;
the values are changed where they are declared and the file is rendered again, never edited here.
c.brief: The numbers plugin-db declares: the length of a digest written in hex.
